investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC investigation per BOTM-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01: one unauthenticated GET to the venue's official_website (WebFetch/curl fallback), with at most one additional same-origin GET when official_programme_url was directly supplied as a candidate field. No browser, authentication, CAPTCHA bypass, or retry loop.

venue_reference: The Vaults — Leake Street, SE1 7NN, London

identity.notes: <title> reads 'The Vaults' and the meta description directly matches the venue name and 'underground world of Waterloo station', consistent with the Leake Street/SE1 discovery address; no cross-domain redirect occurred.

site_classification.platform: Wix single-page application — an embedded router/pagesMap JSON blob lists individual page titles, but no server-rendered event listing was present in the fetched HTML body.

blockers.description: Programming is genuinely mixed (immersive theatre, art, comedy, and only occasional music-branded shows); the venue-level music gate cannot be honestly resolved from a single static GET without deeper, page-by-page filtering.

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated GET exposed an embedded page-router JSON blob naming many individual page/show titles, but this bounded probe cannot classify the venue's *primary* current programme as music vs. non-music from a titles list alone — the mix (immersive theatre, art, comedy, one recurring jazz-branded show) is genuinely ambiguous.

reasons: The meta description self-describes The Vaults as 'a multi-disciplinary space'; the retained keyword scan of the fetched body shows 'art' (426), 'theatre' (20), 'DJ' (29), 'jazz' (12), and 'comedy' (4), but zero 'live music', 'gig', or 'band'.

The retained embedded page-titles excerpt lists shows spanning immersive theatre ('SEEKING SANCTUARY', 'ZOMBIE BLITZ'), a Shakespeare production ('RICHARD II'), an art masterclass, and a recurring music-branded night ('HIDDEN JAZZ CLUB 2026') — genuinely mixed programming, not clearly primary-music.
This is a mixed, multi-disciplinary venue needing deeper page-by-page filtering work to honestly resolve the music gate; that is out of scope for a single bounded Level-1 GET.

evidence.description: Verbatim, byte-faithful <head> excerpt: <title> and meta description, confirming venue identity as a multi-disciplinary space under Waterloo station.
evidence.method: curl -sS -L; descriptive User-Agent; single unauthenticated GET; redirects followed; no retry
